rationale: The instrument exhibits near-zero intraday volatility with a one-cent daily range and relative volume at 0.01x, indicating severe liquidity constraints and no directional momentum. Price is pinned at the session high with no volume expansion or catalyst to break the consolidation, making any directional entry statistically equivalent to a coin flip with elevated execution risk. Preserving capital and the remaining daily loss budget is optimal given the absence of a mechanical edge.
